subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them contains an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.**

The Taj Mahal / is one of / the most beautiful / creation in the world.
solution:
The erroneous part is** "creation in the world"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the usage of "creation" is incorrect instead of this we need to use "creations"
 
• According to grammar, whenever we use "one of" then, we need to use a plural noun after this because we are doing a selection from many hence, we need to use a plural noun after this phrase.
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• He is one of the soldiers who fight for his country.
 
 

**So **the correct sentence is- *The Taj Mahal is one of the most beautiful creations in the world.*
